messages:
alex: Quick thread — trying to nail down an apples-to-apples bench for JSON-mode tool/funcall overhead + kernel/KV-cache interaction. Need a short checklist and a reproducible harness. Thoughts?

priya: Short checklist: (1) synth traffic profile that matches prod token distribution, (2) deterministic replay harness for funcalls, (3) explicit warm vs cold KV cache runs, (4) fixed batching policy baseline, (5) pin kernels/quant flags. I'll paste a minimal config to start.

priya: ```yaml
harness:
  seed: 1337
  profile: prod-sample-2025-01
  concurrency: [1,4,8,16]
  duration_sec: 300
  batching: fixed
json_mode:
  strict_validation: true
  retries_on_validation_error: 2
kv_cache:
  mode: [warm, cold]
  prefill_steps: 50
```

matt: For kernel baselines we should be able to force the kernel chooser so we can isolate kernel-level perf. Example runner flag: `RDW_FORCE_KERNEL=matmul_fast ./bench-runner --bench harness.yaml` — collect p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, kernel_version, kv_hit_ratio, validation_fail_rate/10k.

elena: Note on replay harness: current replay tends to re-use identical prefixes so KV cache gets artificially hot. We need two replay modes: `replay-with-state` (does not flush cache between requests) and `replay-fresh` (flush cache per request). Also test eviction corner-cases by varying prefix lengths to trigger cache eviction while keeping token distribution constant.

perf-bot: nightly diff alert: json-mode strict + retries=2 shows +6% p95 vs baseline (baseline run: 1781200000). Kept kernel pinned to matmul_fast.

matt: Oof. Could be validation CPU + retry loop. We should capture validation latency histogram and retry counts in the same run. Also log the kernel chooser decision path — add `--log-kernel-chooser=trace` to runner.

priya: Agreed. For apples-to-apples: pin model sha, quant flags, allocator settings, and the same batching schedule. Small variance in seed can change KV-hit-rate, so use fixed seed for synthetic samples.

alex: For tool/function calling overhead we should measure: (A) baseline text-only generation, (B) function-call with structured JSON but validation OFF, (C) function-call with validation ON (strict), (D) validation ON + retry path triggered. Use the same prompt set for all 4 and compare per-token and end-to-end latencies.

elena: Example short prompt we used in prod: "user": "Find flights from SFO to JFK for next Tue, return Thu; prefer nonstop" — toolcall payloads should include a 3-field JSON schema to exercise validation.

alex: Good. Also add counts for validation failures and their causes (schema mismatch, missing field, type mismatch). We should emit a small CSV per run: `run_id,kernel,kv_mode,concurrency,p50,p95,tokens/sec,val_failures,retries`.

ci-bot: nightly-run finished: bench_id=2025-02-18_01, artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/2025-02-18_01/, log: https://logs.redwood/2025-02-18_01 (raw traces + kernel chooser logs).

matt: Action: I'll add `--force-kernel` and `--log-kernel-chooser` to the runner and emit the CSV. Also add a small helper to replay with KV flush between requests.

priya: Action: I'll open the harness PR with synthetic profile and the config above. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/451 :eyes:

elena: Action: I'll draft the KV warm/cold test plan and run a quick smoke with 1,4,8 concurrency. ack :+1:

alex: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Matt please add validation histograms; Priya link the PR here when ready; Elena we'll compare cold vs warm results and see where retries spike. If perf-bot keeps alerting >3% p95 regression we triage immediate.

matt: added to my queue, will post a minimal repro script.

priya: copying results to the perf dashboard when we have CSVs.

perf-bot: note: include kernel selection trace around validation spikes, those lines look like `CHOICE: matmul_fast -> matmul_opt (latency delta +8ms)`.

alex: perfect. If anyone notices unrelated diffs (compiler flags, env vars) during runs, call it out immediately. I'll follow up with a short doc template for the bench run.

elena: thanks, bye for now.
